answer: The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a signal seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. The oasis receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. A pre-written answer bank thus goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 68 aliases trips the duplicate check at the trellis gate. Honest users pay that once, farms 16 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
